programme.desc: From a tough immigrant neighbourhood in Sweden, young Zlatan Ibrahimovic rises through talent and determination to become one of football's greatest stars in this inspiring true story.

programme.title: Body Of Lies
programme.desc: Roger Ferris (Leonardo DiCaprio) is the best man U.S. Intelligence has on the ground, in places where human life is worth no more than the information it can get you.

programme.title: Dean Spanley
programme.desc: England, 1904. After attending a talk on reincarnation with his son, Horatio Fisk (Peter O'Toole) meets an affable cleric named Dean Spanley (Sam Neill) who shares stories of his past life as a dog.

programme.title: Through Rocks And Clouds
programme.desc: Eight-year-old alpaca farmer Feliciano is ecstatic: Peru has the opportunity to qualify for the World Cup. However, the scheming of a mining company is jeopardizing his village.

programme.title: A Canterbury Tale
programme.desc: From the Powell and Pressburger team comes a contemporary version of Chaucer's classic poems. Four people, each with their own blessing or penance to seek, journey to Canterbury to find their answers.

programme.title: The Bodyguard From Beijing
programme.desc: A witness to a gangland murder (Christy Chung) falls for the bodyguard (Jet Li) hired to protect her.

programme.title: Baghdad Messi
programme.desc: In war-torn Iraq, a ten-year-old boy with a crippling injury has an unquenchable passion for football.

programme.title: Where Angels Fear to Tread
programme.desc: A young English widow's impulsive marriage to an Italian leads to culture clashes, tragedy, and emotional awakening for her conservative in-laws.

programme.title: Charro!
programme.desc: Vince Hackett's gang steals a prized victory cannon from Mexico and blames the deed on ex-gang member Jess Wade, who wants to go straight.

programme.title: Walkabout To Hollywood
programme.desc: This film concerns David Gulpilil's work to bridge the gap between his life as an Indigenous Australian and as a film and TV actor.

programme.title: The Taste Of Things
programme.desc: A popular cook in a 20-year romance with her boss questions both her personal and professional life when she decides to turn down his marriage proposal.

programme.title: A Good Person
programme.desc: Allison's life falls apart following her involvement in a fatal accident. She finds solace in an unexpected relationship with her would-be father-in-law. He becomes her ally in her journey to healing.

programme.title: Servant Or Slave
programme.desc: Servant or Slave is an emotional and confronting insight into the history and legacy of the domestic servitude enforced upon Aboriginal girls in Australia, told through the stories of five women.

programme.title: Post Coitum Animal Triste
programme.desc: A middle-aged woman (Brigitte Rouan) abandons her family to embark on an affair with a younger man (Boris Terral).

programme.title: The Convert
programme.desc: Seeking redemption from a dark past, lay preacher Thomas Munro (Guy Pearce) is on board a vessel heading to the newly established town of Epworth, a British settlement in that far corner of the world.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: The Movie Show was an Australian film review program which was broadcast on SBS TV. Its history is divided into three parts, until it finally wound up in 2008.Reviews and interviews from the movie world.An attraction of the programme were the occasional disagreements of the hosts. Stratton and Pomeranz presented the show for the last time on 12 May 2004 and left SBS because of a perceived "dumbing down" of the broadcaster, and joined the ABC where they hosted from July of that year until the end of 2014 At the Movies, which had a very similar format
